name: Devil's Journal - Tony T
source:
Tony receives an invitation from the girl he likes, only to find her dead. The day after he receives the invitation again, but he finds her dead again. A new day, a new death from the same person. What's happening? Who's the culprit? Why do these strange phenomena happen? Why does it seem that the world turned against Tony? This is the first full-fledged Visual Novel from DANGEMU.

[Edited From [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/devils-journal-tony-t]IndieDB[/url]]
translation:
托尼收到心仪女孩的邀请，却发现她已经死了。第二天，他再次收到邀请，却又发现她死了。

新的一天，来自同一个人的新死亡。

究竟发生了什么？凶手是谁？为什么会出现这些奇怪的现象？为什么世界仿佛都与托尼为敌？

这是 DANGEMU 制作的第一部完整视觉小说。

[改编自 [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/devils-journal-tony-t]IndieDB[/url]]
